item.title: Orbit 0.9.1
item.description:
Copy and paste, both ways — and Orbit now keeps itself up to date.

What's new

📋 Copy on your phone, paste on your Mac

The clipboard now works in both directions. Copy anything on your phone — a WhatsApp message, a link in Chrome, a code — and it's ready to paste on your Mac a moment later, with a quiet "Copied from your phone" so you know it arrived. Tap any item in Orbit's clipboard history and it lands on both devices.

Android only lets the app on screen read what you copy, so Orbit asks for one switch the first time: open Orbit › Settings › Phone to Mac and turn on "Orbit — copy to your Mac". It only looks at what you copy, never your screen, and it skips passwords.

⬆️ Orbit updates itself

From this version on you won't need to visit the website again. On your Mac, Orbit shows the familiar "A new version is available" window; on your phone, a small card with an Update button. One tap — your connection and history stay put.

✨ Smoother

Faster pickup when you copy, smarter handling of duplicates, and a more reliable connection.

Updating from 0.9.0

This is the last time you'll update by hand:

  • Mac — download Orbit-macOS.dmg and drag Orbit into Applications, replacing the old one.
  • Android — download Orbit-Android.apk and install it over the current version. Your pairing and history are kept.

Known limitations

  • The Mac build isn't notarized yet: the first launch needs System Settings › Privacy & Security › Open Anyway.
  • Android 12+ briefly shows its own "Orbit pasted from your clipboard" notice when you copy — that's Android's privacy notice.
  • Call audio still stays on your phone; it's next on our list.
